#Created so we can call on extracted steps and linear features and others can 
#run it more easily 

```{r setup}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(amt)
library(survival)
select <- dplyr::select
```

##1. Load extracted steps

```{r load}
combined_path <- here("outputs", "etosha_extract_hr1_lcmixed.rds")

if (file.exists(combined_path)) {
  ele_trk_extract_etosha <- readRDS(combined_path)
} else {
  etosha_dir <- list.files(here("data"), pattern = "^batch_output_etosha_hr1_lcmixed_",
                           full.names = TRUE)
  stopifnot(length(etosha_dir) == 1)
  files <- list.files(etosha_dir, pattern = "pipeline_batch_.*\\.rds", full.names = TRUE)
  ele_trk_extract_etosha <- map_dfr(files, readRDS)
  saveRDS(ele_trk_extract_etosha, combined_path)
}

nrow(ele_trk_extract_etosha)  # 7,245,194
```

## 2. Prep: unique strata, crossing indicators, land cover NAs

```{r prep}
lin_cols <- c("kaza_vet_fences_linear", "roads_linear", "hydrorivers_linear")
stopifnot(all(lin_cols %in% names(ele_trk_extract_etosha)))

ele_trk_extract_etosha <- ele_trk_extract_etosha |>
  mutate(
    step_id_ = paste(id, step_id_, sep = "_"),          # avoid stratum collisions across ids
    across(all_of(lin_cols), ~ if_else(is.infinite(.x) | is.na(.x), 0, .x)),  # -Inf/NA = no feature
    fence_cross = as.integer(kaza_vet_fences_linear > 0),
    road_cross  = as.integer(roads_linear > 0),
    river_cross = as.integer(hydrorivers_linear > 0),    # any stream order (1-3)
    across(c(grassland, shrubland, tree_cover), ~ replace_na(.x, 0))
  )

ele_trk_extract_etosha_wet <- ele_trk_extract_etosha |> filter(season == "wet")
ele_trk_extract_etosha_dry <- ele_trk_extract_etosha |> filter(season == "dry")


saveRDS(ele_trk_extract_etosha, here("outputs", "ele_trk_extract_etosha_linecross.rds"))
```

## 3. Checks: crossing counts and overlap with distance-to terms

```{r checks}
check_crossings <- function(d) {
  list(
    counts = d |> group_by(case_) |>
      summarise(fence = sum(fence_cross), road = sum(road_cross), river = sum(river_cross)),
    cor = c(fence = cor(d$fence_dist, d$fence_cross, use = "complete.obs"),
            road  = cor(d$road_dist, d$road_cross, use = "complete.obs"),
            river = cor(d$water_rivers_dist, d$river_cross, use = "complete.obs"))
  )
}

check_crossings(ele_trk_extract_etosha_wet)
check_crossings(ele_trk_extract_etosha_dry)
```

## 4. Fit main SSF + step-length robustness check

Main model has no movement terms. The `slcheck` model adds `sl_` + `log_sl_` only to test
whether crossing coefficients are confounded with step length; it is not the reported model.
Note `sl_` is in degrees here (track built in EPSG:4326); fine for this comparison.

Fitting is slow (~3.5M rows per season), so fits are cached.

```{r fit}
fits_path <- here("outputs", "etosha_ssf_crossing_fits.rds")

f_main <- case_ ~ fence_dist + road_dist + water_rivers_dist +
  cropland_dist + grassland + shrubland + urban_dist + tree_cover +
  elevation + slope + aspect + evi + world_pop +
  fence_cross + road_cross + river_cross + strata(step_id_)

f_slcheck <- update(f_main, . ~ . + sl_ + log_sl_)

fit_season <- function(d) {
  d <- d |> mutate(log_sl_ = log(sl_))
  list(main    = fit_clogit(d, f_main, model = FALSE),
       slcheck = fit_clogit(d, f_slcheck, model = FALSE))
}

if (file.exists(fits_path)) {
  etosha_fits <- readRDS(fits_path)
} else {
  etosha_fits <- list(wet = fit_season(ele_trk_extract_etosha_wet),
                      dry = fit_season(ele_trk_extract_etosha_dry))
  saveRDS(etosha_fits, fits_path)
}

summary(etosha_fits$wet$main)
summary(etosha_fits$dry$main)
```

## 5. Robustness table

`shift_over_se` = change in crossing coefficient when step length is added, in units of the
main model's SE. |shift| < 1 SE = robust.

```{r robustness}
cross_terms <- c("fence_cross", "road_cross", "river_cross")

robustness <- map_dfr(names(etosha_fits), function(s) {
  m  <- summary(etosha_fits[[s]]$main)$coefficients[cross_terms, ]
  sc <- summary(etosha_fits[[s]]$slcheck)$coefficients[cross_terms, ]
  tibble(season = s, term = cross_terms,
         coef_main = m[, "coef"], se_main = m[, "se(coef)"],
         rel_sel_main = exp(m[, "coef"]),
         coef_sl = sc[, "coef"],
         shift_over_se = (sc[, "coef"] - m[, "coef"]) / m[, "se(coef)"])
})
robustness
```

## 6. Do crossings improve the model? (AIC/BIC, same rows)

```{r aic}
compare_crossing <- function(data, label) {
  d <- data |>
    drop_na(fence_dist, road_dist, water_rivers_dist, cropland_dist, urban_dist,
            grassland, shrubland, tree_cover, elevation, slope, aspect, evi, world_pop,
            fence_cross, road_cross, river_cross)

  base  <- fit_clogit(d, update(f_main, . ~ . - fence_cross - road_cross - river_cross),
                      model = FALSE)
  cross <- fit_clogit(d, f_main, model = FALSE)

  tibble(season = label, model = c("base", "+ crossings"),
         AIC = c(AIC(base$model), AIC(cross$model)),
         BIC = c(BIC(base$model), BIC(cross$model))) |>
    mutate(dAIC = AIC - min(AIC), dBIC = BIC - min(BIC))
}

aic_path <- here("outputs", "etosha_crossing_aic.rds")
if (file.exists(aic_path)) {
  crossing_aic <- readRDS(aic_path)
} else {
  crossing_aic <- bind_rows(compare_crossing(ele_trk_extract_etosha_wet, "Etosha wet"),
                            compare_crossing(ele_trk_extract_etosha_dry, "Etosha dry"))
  saveRDS(crossing_aic, aic_path)
}
crossing_aic
```
## 7. Three linear-feature scenarios

1. Distance-to only (`base` from section 6)
2. Distance-to + crossings (`main` from section 4)
3. Crossings replace distance-to for fences and roads (and rivers, via `river_cross`)

`water_rivers_dist` is kept in scenario 3 by default: it comes from the land-cover water
class (pans, waterholes), not the HydroRIVERS line layer, so it is mostly a water-access
habitat effect. Set `drop_water <- TRUE` to also drop it.

Only scenario 3 is fit here. Rows are filtered on the same variable set as section 6, so `n`
matches across all three scenarios and AIC is comparable.

```{r scenarios}
drop_water <- FALSE

f_cross_only <- update(f_main, . ~ . - fence_dist - road_dist)
if (drop_water) f_cross_only <- update(f_cross_only, . ~ . - water_rivers_dist)

fit_cross_only <- function(data) {
  d <- data |>
    drop_na(fence_dist, road_dist, water_rivers_dist, cropland_dist, urban_dist,
            grassland, shrubland, tree_cover, elevation, slope, aspect, evi, world_pop,
            fence_cross, road_cross, river_cross)
  fit_clogit(d, f_cross_only, model = FALSE)
}

cross_only_path <- here("outputs", paste0("etosha_ssf_crossonly_fits",
                                          if (drop_water) "_nowater", ".rds"))
if (file.exists(cross_only_path)) {
  cross_only_fits <- readRDS(cross_only_path)
} else {
  cross_only_fits <- list(wet = fit_cross_only(ele_trk_extract_etosha_wet),
                          dry = fit_cross_only(ele_trk_extract_etosha_dry))
  saveRDS(cross_only_fits, cross_only_path)
}

scenario_table <- map_dfr(c("wet", "dry"), function(s) {
  label <- paste("Etosha", s)
  prev  <- crossing_aic |> filter(season == label)
  m3    <- cross_only_fits[[s]]$model
  stopifnot(m3$n == etosha_fits[[s]]$main$model$n)   # same rows as scenarios 1-2

  tibble(season = s,
         scenario = c("1. distance-to only", "2. distance-to + crossings",
                      "3. crossings replace distance-to"),
         n   = m3$n,   # identical across scenarios (checked above; base used the same drop_na rows)
         AIC = c(prev$AIC, AIC(m3)),
         BIC = c(prev$BIC, BIC(m3))) |>
    mutate(dAIC = AIC - min(AIC), dBIC = BIC - min(BIC))
})
scenario_table

# crossing coefficients with vs without the distance-to terms
map_dfr(c("wet", "dry"), function(s) {
  tibble(season = s, term = cross_terms,
         with_dist    = coef(etosha_fits[[s]]$main$model)[cross_terms],
         without_dist = coef(cross_only_fits[[s]]$model)[cross_terms])
})
```

```{r coef-compare}
base_path <- here("outputs", "etosha_ssf_base_fits.rds")
f_base <- update(f_main, . ~ . - fence_cross - road_cross - river_cross)

if (file.exists(base_path)) {
  base_fits <- readRDS(base_path)
} else {
  fit_base <- function(data) {
    d <- data |>
      drop_na(fence_dist, road_dist, water_rivers_dist, cropland_dist, urban_dist,
              grassland, shrubland, tree_cover, elevation, slope, aspect, evi, world_pop,
              fence_cross, road_cross, river_cross)
    fit_clogit(d, f_base, model = FALSE)
  }
  base_fits <- list(wet = fit_base(ele_trk_extract_etosha_wet),
                    dry = fit_base(ele_trk_extract_etosha_dry))
  saveRDS(base_fits, base_path)
}

coef_compare <- map_dfr(c("wet", "dry"), function(s) {
  b  <- coef(base_fits[[s]]$model)
  m  <- coef(etosha_fits[[s]]$main$model)
  mv <- coef(etosha_fits[[s]]$slcheck$model)
  se <- sqrt(diag(vcov(etosha_fits[[s]]$main$model)))
  terms <- names(m)
  tibble(season = s, term = terms,
         base = b[terms], with_cross = m, with_move = mv[terms], se_main = se,
         shift_cross_se = (m - b[terms]) / se,     # effect of adding crossings
         shift_move_se  = (mv[terms] - m) / se)    # effect of adding movement terms
})

coef_compare |> arrange(season, desc(abs(shift_cross_se)))
coef_compare |> arrange(season, desc(abs(shift_move_se)))

#concordance, just for reference only (we determined this is not model-selection criterion for matched designs)
map_dfr(c("wet", "dry"), ~ tibble(
  season = .x,
  base       = summary(base_fits[[.x]])$concordance[1],
  with_cross = summary(etosha_fits[[.x]]$main)$concordance[1],
  with_move  = summary(etosha_fits[[.x]]$slcheck)$concordance[1]))
```

## Helpers

```{r helpers}
# clean_names() may have stripped amt's trailing underscores, so look for either version
pick_col <- function(d, opts) {
  hit <- intersect(opts, names(d))
  if (length(hit) == 0) stop("None of these columns found: ", paste(opts, collapse = ", "))
  hit[1]
}

standardize_cols <- function(d) {
  map <- c(x1_ = pick_col(d, c("x1_", "x1")), y1_ = pick_col(d, c("y1_", "y1")),
           x2_ = pick_col(d, c("x2_", "x2")), y2_ = pick_col(d, c("y2_", "y2")),
           case_ = pick_col(d, c("case_", "case")), sl_ = pick_col(d, c("sl_", "sl")))
  # coordinates are degrees, so amt's sl_ is in degrees too. Step length in metres (good approximation at 1-hr steps):
  d |> rename(any_of(setNames(map, names(map)))) |>
    mutate(sl_m = sqrt(((x2_ - x1_) * 111320 * cos((y1_ + y2_) / 2 * pi / 180))^2 +
                       ((y2_ - y1_) * 110574)^2),
           log_sl_m = log(pmax(sl_m, 1)))
}

# Step lines in batches -> TRUE if the step line intersects any feature line
cross_vec <- function(d, lines, batch = 250000) {
  out <- logical(nrow(d))
  idx <- split(seq_len(nrow(d)), ceiling(seq_len(nrow(d)) / batch))
  for (i in seq_along(idx)) {
    ii <- idx[[i]]
    ok <- ii[d$sl_[ii] > 0 & !is.na(d$x2_[ii])]   # zero-length / NA steps can't cross
    if (length(ok)) {
      df <- tibble(id = rep(seq_along(ok), each = 2),
                   x  = as.vector(rbind(d$x1_[ok], d$x2_[ok])),
                   y  = as.vector(rbind(d$y1_[ok], d$y2_[ok])))
      sl <- sfheaders::sf_linestring(df, x = "x", y = "y", linestring_id = "id") |>
        st_set_crs(st_crs(lines))
      out[ok] <- lengths(st_intersects(sl, lines)) > 0
    }
    cat(sprintf("  batch %d/%d done\n", i, length(idx)))
  }
  as.integer(out)
}

# Raster version of a crossing, for when there's no fence vector.
# any    = step line passes through a fence cell (what the old 500 m method did; blends proximity)
# strict = passes through a fence cell AND neither endpoint is in a fence cell
#          (removes steps that end on, or walk along, the fence; can miss real crossings that end right past it)
cross_rast <- function(d, r, batch = 250000) {
  is_fence <- function(v) !is.na(v) & v > 0
  any_ <- logical(nrow(d))
  idx <- split(seq_len(nrow(d)), ceiling(seq_len(nrow(d)) / batch))
  for (i in seq_along(idx)) {
    ii <- idx[[i]]
    ok <- ii[d$sl_[ii] > 0 & !is.na(d$x2_[ii])]
    if (length(ok)) {
      df <- tibble(id = rep(seq_along(ok), each = 2),
                   x  = as.vector(rbind(d$x1_[ok], d$x2_[ok])),
                   y  = as.vector(rbind(d$y1_[ok], d$y2_[ok])))
      sl <- sfheaders::sf_linestring(df, x = "x", y = "y", linestring_id = "id") |>
        st_set_crs(st_crs(crs_steps))
      e <- terra::extract(r, vect(sl), fun = max, na.rm = TRUE)
      any_[ok] <- is_fence(e[, 2])
    }
    cat(sprintf("  batch %d/%d done\n", i, length(idx)))
  }
  start_in <- is_fence(terra::extract(r, cbind(d$x1_, d$y1_))[, 1])
  end_in   <- is_fence(terra::extract(r, cbind(d$x2_, d$y2_))[, 1])
  tibble(any = as.integer(any_), strict = as.integer(any_ & !start_in & !end_in))
}

# Rasterize lines on the 500 m template, then distance (m) to nearest line cell
dist_raster <- function(lines) {
  r <- rasterize(vect(lines), tmpl, touches = TRUE)
  distance(r)
}

prep_lines <- function(x, bbox_sf) {
  x |> st_zm() |> st_transform(crs_steps) |>
    st_filter(bbox_sf) |> select(any_of(c("HYRIV_ID", "UPLAND_SKM", "DIS_AV_CMS")))
}
```

## Checkpoint 1: steps load, columns, bad fixes

Load one file at a time (both at once crashed R last time).

```{r check-steps}
bb_all <- NULL
for (s in names(STEP_FILES)) {
  d <- readRDS(STEP_FILES[[s]]) |> standardize_cols()
  stopifnot(STRATA_COL %in% names(d))
  cat("\n==", s, "==  rows:", nrow(d), " strata:", n_distinct(d[[STRATA_COL]]), "\n")
  print(table(d$case_))

  # Bad fixes: used 1-hr steps > 8 km. MET23/MET42 caused West's wet-season artifact.
  cat("sl_ range (degrees?):", round(range(d$sl_, na.rm = TRUE), 4), "  sl_m median (m):", round(median(d$sl_m[d$case_ == 1], na.rm = TRUE)), "\n")
  bad <- d |> filter(case_ == 1, sl_m > 8000)
  cat("Used steps > 8 km:", nrow(bad), "\n")
  if (nrow(bad) > 0 && "id" %in% names(d)) print(count(bad, id, sort = TRUE))
  if (any(c("MET23", "MET42") %in% d$id)) warning("MET23/MET42 present in Etosha ", s, ": inspect before fitting")

  bb_s <- st_as_sfc(st_bbox(c(xmin = min(d$x2_, na.rm = TRUE), ymin = min(d$y2_, na.rm = TRUE),
                              xmax = max(d$x2_, na.rm = TRUE), ymax = max(d$y2_, na.rm = TRUE)),
                            crs = st_crs(crs_steps)))
  bb_all <- if (is.null(bb_all)) bb_s else st_union(bb_all, bb_s)
  rm(d); gc()
}
b <- st_bbox(bb_all)
bb_pop <- st_as_sfc(st_bbox(c(xmin = b[["xmin"]] - 0.2, ymin = b[["ymin"]] - 0.2,
                               xmax = b[["xmax"]] + 0.2, ymax = b[["ymax"]] + 0.2),
                             crs = st_crs(crs_steps)))   # ~20 km margin
```

**Stop here if** there are many > 8 km used steps concentrated in one or two collars. Drop those fixes and regenerate steps before going on.

## Build the feature lines

```{r lines}
fences    <- if (!is.null(FENCE_VEC)) st_read(FENCE_VEC, quiet = TRUE) |> prep_lines(bb_pop) else NULL
perennial <- st_read(PERENNIAL,  quiet = TRUE) |> prep_lines(bb_pop)

# Ephemeral rivers: same rule as West and the earlier maps.
# If read_hr() is loaded, this matches the earlier Etosha check exactly
# (bb_etosha_hr = the bbox object you passed to read_hr() before).
if (exists("read_hr") && exists("bb_etosha_hr")) {
  ephemeral <- read_hr(bb_etosha_hr, min_upland = 1000) |>
    filter(DIS_AV_CMS < 10) |> prep_lines(bb_pop)
} else {
  bb_ll <- st_as_text(st_transform(bb_pop, 4326))
  ephemeral <- st_read(HR_AFRICA, layer = HR_LAYER, wkt_filter = bb_ll, quiet = TRUE) |>
    filter(UPLAND_SKM >= 1000, DIS_AV_CMS < 10) |> prep_lines(bb_pop)
}
roads <- if (!is.null(ROAD_PATH)) st_read(ROAD_PATH, quiet = TRUE) |> prep_lines(bb_pop) else NULL

fence_cells_pop <- global(crop(fence_r, vect(bb_pop)) > 0, "sum", na.rm = TRUE)[1, 1]
cat("Fence cells in Etosha extent:", fence_cells_pop, " fence vector:", if (is.null(fences)) "none (raster crossings)" else nrow(fences),
    " perennial:", nrow(perennial), " ephemeral:", nrow(ephemeral),
    " roads:", if (is.null(roads)) "raster kept" else nrow(roads), "\n")
stopifnot(fence_cells_pop > 0, nrow(ephemeral) > 0)

st_write(ephemeral, here("data", "Linear_features", "etosha_ephemeral_rivers_hydrorivers_1k.gpkg"),
         delete_dsn = TRUE, quiet = TRUE)
```

```{r map, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 7}
nrow(ephemeral)                           # 399
st_write(ephemeral, here("data", "Linear_features", "etosha_ephemeral_rivers_hydrorivers_1k.gpkg"),
         delete_dsn = TRUE, quiet = TRUE)

ggplot(ephemeral) + geom_sf(colour = "goldenrod") + theme_minimal()   # Cuvelai channels should now be gold
```

## Distance rasters and extraction

```{r dist-rasters}
# fence_dist_r comes straight from Marissa's dist_vetfences_500m.tif (loaded in `paths`)
eph_dist_r   <- dist_raster(ephemeral)
writeRaster(eph_dist_r,  here("data", "Linear_features", "etosha_ephemeral_rivers_dist_1k_500m.tif"), overwrite = TRUE)
```

```{r extract}
for (s in names(STEP_FILES)) {
  cat("\n==", s, "==\n")
  d <- readRDS(STEP_FILES[[s]]) |> standardize_cols()
  bad_strata <- d[[STRATA_COL]][d$case_ == 1 & d$sl_m > 8000]
  d <- d[!d[[STRATA_COL]] %in% bad_strata, ]
  cat("Dropped", length(bad_strata), "strata with used steps > 8 km\n")
  xy <- cbind(d$x2_, d$y2_)

  # keep the old raster-based values for comparison
  d <- d |> rename(any_of(c(fence_dist_old = "fence_dist", fence_cross_r500 = "fence_cross",
                            river_cross_r500 = "river_cross")))

  # endpoint distances (km, so coefficients are readable; match however your other dist terms are scaled)
  d$fence_dist             <- terra::extract(fence_dist_r, xy)[, 1] / 1000
  d$ephemeral_rivers_dist  <- terra::extract(eph_dist_r,  xy)[, 1] / 1000
  d$ephemeral_rivers_prox  <- exp(-d$ephemeral_rivers_dist)   # = exp(-d_m / 1000), same as West

  # vector crossings
  cat("fences\n")
  if (!is.null(fences)) {
    d$fence_cross <- cross_vec(d, fences)
  } else {
    fc <- cross_rast(d, fence_r)
    d$fence_cross_any <- fc$any
    d$fence_cross     <- fc$strict   # model uses strict; compare counts with _any and _r500 at checkpoint 3
  }
  cat("perennial\n"); d$river_cross     <- cross_vec(d, perennial)
  cat("ephemeral\n"); d$ephemeral_cross <- cross_vec(d, ephemeral)
  if (!is.null(roads)) {
    d <- d |> rename(any_of(c(road_cross_r500 = "road_cross")))
    cat("roads\n"); d$road_cross <- cross_vec(d, roads)
  }

  stopifnot(!anyNA(d$fence_dist), !anyNA(d$ephemeral_rivers_dist))
  saveRDS(d, here("outputs", sprintf("ele_trk_extract_etosha_%s_v2.rds", s)))
  rm(d); gc()
}
```

## Checkpoint 3: crossing counts and collinearity

```{r check-cross}
cross_summary <- map_dfr(names(STEP_FILES), function(s) {
  d <- readRDS(here("outputs", sprintf("ele_trk_extract_etosha_%s_v2.rds", s)))
  out <- d |>
    select(case_, any_of(c("fence_cross", "fence_cross_any", "fence_cross_r500","river_cross", "river_cross_r500",
                           "ephemeral_cross", "road_cross"))) |>
    pivot_longer(-case_, names_to = "term", values_to = "x") |>
    group_by(term, case_) |> summarise(n_cross = sum(x, na.rm = TRUE), rate = mean(x, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
    pivot_wider(names_from = case_, values_from = c(n_cross, rate), names_glue = "{.value}_{ifelse(case_ == 1, 'used', 'random')}") |>
    mutate(season = s, ratio_used_random = rate_used / rate_random)
  rm(d); gc(); out
})
cross_summary |> arrange(term, season) |> print(n = Inf)
```

How to read it: `ratio_used_random` near 1 means no barrier, well below 1 means a barrier. Vector counts should be **lower** than the `_r500` versions (the raster counted near-misses). Any term with fewer than `MIN_USED_CROSS` used crossings in a season gets dropped from that season's model below.

```{r check-cor}
d <- readRDS(here("outputs", "ele_trk_extract_etosha_dry_v2.rds")) |> slice_sample(n = 200000)
cand <- intersect(c("ephemeral_rivers_dist", "ephemeral_rivers_prox", "ephemeral_cross", "water_rivers_dist",
                    "river_cross", "road_cross", "road_dist", "fence_dist", "fence_cross"), names(d))
cm <- cor(d[, cand], use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
print(round(cm, 2))
flag <- which(abs(cm) > 0.6 & upper.tri(cm), arr.ind = TRUE)
if (nrow(flag)) { cat("\n|r| > 0.6:\n"); print(tibble(a = rownames(cm)[flag[, 1]], b = colnames(cm)[flag[, 2]], r = cm[flag])) }
rm(d); gc()
```

(`ephemeral_rivers_dist` and `_prox` will correlate with each other. That's fine, since they're never in the same model.)

## Fit models

**Match `hab_terms` to the Etosha main model in `linear_features_ssf_etosha.Rmd`** (Etosha base drops `core_dist`, keeps `elevation` and `water_rivers_dist`). The list below is the KAZA one: edit it.

```{r fit}
hab_terms  <- c("elevation", "slope", "aspect", "evi", "world_pop", "tree_cover", "shrubland",
                "grassland", "water_rivers_dist", "cropland_dist", "urban_dist")
dist_terms <- c("road_dist", "fence_dist")

fit_one <- function(terms, d) {
  f <- reformulate(c(terms, sprintf("strata(%s)", STRATA_COL)), response = "case_")
  clogit(f, data = d, model = FALSE)
}

tidy_ci <- function(m) {
  s <- summary(m)$coefficients; ci <- confint(m)
  tibble(term = rownames(s), coef = s[, "coef"], se = s[, "se(coef)"],
         exp_coef = exp(s[, "coef"]), lo95 = exp(ci[, 1]), hi95 = exp(ci[, 2]), p = s[, "Pr(>|z|)"])
}

results <- list()
for (s in names(STEP_FILES)) {
  cat("\n== fitting", s, "==\n")
  d <- readRDS(here("outputs", sprintf("ele_trk_extract_etosha_%s_v2.rds", s)))

  # which crossing terms have enough data this season
  cs <- cross_summary |> filter(season == s)
  enough <- function(t) isTRUE(cs$n_cross_used[cs$term == t] >= MIN_USED_CROSS)
  cross_terms <- c("road_cross", "river_cross", if (enough("fence_cross")) "fence_cross")
  cat("Crossing terms used:", paste(cross_terms, collapse = ", "), "\n")
  if (!enough("ephemeral_cross")) warning("Too few ephemeral crossings in ", s)

  base <- c(hab_terms, dist_terms, cross_terms)
  specs <- list(
    `1. base (new fences, vector crossings)` = base,
    `2. + eph dist`                          = c(base, "ephemeral_rivers_dist"),
    `3. + eph prox`                          = c(base, "ephemeral_rivers_prox"),
    `4. + eph dist + eph cross`              = c(base, "ephemeral_rivers_dist", "ephemeral_cross"),
    `5. + eph prox + eph cross`              = c(base, "ephemeral_rivers_prox", "ephemeral_cross")
  )
  fits <- map(specs, fit_one, d = d)

  aic_tab <- tibble(season = s, model = names(fits),
                    AIC = map_dbl(fits, AIC), BIC = map_dbl(fits, BIC)) |>
    mutate(dAIC = AIC - min(AIC), dBIC = BIC - min(BIC))

  # step-length check on the best ephemeral model
  best_eph <- aic_tab |> filter(model != names(specs)[1]) |> slice_min(AIC) |> pull(model)
  m_sl  <- fit_one(c(specs[[best_eph]], "sl_m", "log_sl_m"), d)
  shift <- tidy_ci(fits[[best_eph]]) |> select(term, coef, se) |>
    inner_join(tidy_ci(m_sl) |> select(term, coef_sl = coef), by = "term") |>
    mutate(season = s, shift_move_se = (coef_sl - coef) / se)

  results[[s]] <- list(aic = aic_tab,
                       coefs = imap_dfr(fits, ~ tidy_ci(.x) |> mutate(model = .y, season = s)),
                       shift = shift, best_eph = best_eph)
  rm(d, fits, m_sl); gc()
}
saveRDS(results, here("outputs", "etosha_ssf_v2_results.rds"))
```

## Results

```{r results}
aic_all <- map_dfr(results, "aic"); print(aic_all)

# the terms the team asked about
map_dfr(results, "coefs") |>
  filter(str_detect(term, "ephemeral|fence|river_cross|road_cross")) |>
  arrange(season, model, term) |> print(n = Inf)

# step-length robustness: |shift| < 2 SE = robust
map_dfr(results, "shift") |> filter(str_detect(term, "cross|ephemeral")) |> print(n = Inf)

# do the habitat coefficients move when ephemeral terms are added? (base vs best)
map_dfr(names(results), function(s) {
  cf <- results[[s]]$coefs
  inner_join(cf |> filter(model == "1. base (new fences, vector crossings)") |> select(term, coef, se),
             cf |> filter(model == results[[s]]$best_eph) |> select(term, coef_eph = coef), by = "term") |>
    mutate(season = s, shift_se = (coef_eph - coef) / se)
}) |> filter(term %in% hab_terms) |> arrange(desc(abs(shift_se))) |> print()
```
